parts.markdown:
Use the ideas from your reading and Candidate List to answer these five questions. Choose the strongest answer for each. These questions ask you to interpret examples and decide what to do next.

You can check each answer, read its explanation, and revise your choice. The feedback helps you examine your thinking; it does not calculate a grade.

When you have answered all five, copy your final answers into the Canvas assignment text-entry box and submit there. Your instructor reviews completion for the five points. Keep your Candidate List for the four checks that follow.
